themes.title: Cognizant launches Claude capability group
themes.text: Cognizant formed a Claude Frontier Capability Group with over 25,000 professionals to deliver Anthropic's AI assistant to clients.

stories.headline: Cognizant forms Claude Frontier Capability Group with 25,000 staff

themes.title: Froncort.AI receives funding for health surveillance
themes.text: Pune-based Froncort.AI secured $2.3 million from Google.org to expand its mobile AI disease surveillance platform to three states.

stories.headline: Froncort.AI raises $2.3M from Google.org to expand AI disease surveillance

themes.title: Bombay High Court quashes AI-hallucinated order
themes.text: The Bombay High Court quashed a customs order because the decision cited two non-existent Supreme Court judgments generated by AI.

stories.headline: Bombay High Court quashes customs order citing AI-hallucinated judgments
